input.command: python3 -c 'import os, json, duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True); p="data/crashes.parquet"; q=f"select isodow(crash_date) as dow, strftime(crash_date, %s) as weekday, count(*) as crashes from read_parquet(%s) where crash_date >= date %s and crash_date < date %s group by 1,2 order by 1"; df=duckdb.sql(q, params=["%A", p, "2013-01-01", "2026-01-01"]).df(); order=["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"]; df["weekday"]=pd.Categorical(df.weekday, categories=order, ordered=True); df=df.sort_values("weekday").reset_index(drop=True); total=int(df.crashes.sum()); df["share_percent"]=df.crashes/total*100; cal=pd.date_range("2013-01-01","2025-12-31",freq="D"); days=pd.Series(cal.day_name()).value_counts().reindex(order); df["calendar_days"]=df.weekday.astype(str).map(days).astype(int); df["average_crashes_per_day"]=df.crashes/df.calendar_days; d1=df[["weekday","crashes","share_percent"]].copy(); d1.to_csv("out/values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f"); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.2)); bars=ax.barh(order, d1.share_percent, color="#3b82a0"); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("Share of all police-reported crashes (%)"); ax.set_title("NYC crashes by weekday, 2013–2025"); ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=.22); ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{int(n):,}  ({s:.1f}%)" for n,s in zip(df.crashes,df.share_percent)], padding=4, fontsize=9); ax.set_xlim(0, max(d1.share_percent)*1.25); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("out/option_1.png", dpi=180); plt.close(fig); d2=df[["weekday","crashes","calendar_days","average_crashes_per_day"]].copy(); d2.to_csv("out/values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f"); fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.2)); bars=ax.bar(order, d2.average_crashes_per_day, color="#ce8b45"); ax.set_ylabel("Average crashes per calendar day"); ax.set_title("Average NYC crashes per weekday occurrence, 2013–2025"); ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.22); ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{x:,.1f}" for x in d2.average_crashes_per_day], padding=3, fontsize=9); ax.set_ylim(0, max(d2.average_crashes_per_day)*1.15); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("out/option_2.png", dpi=180); plt.close(fig); print(d1.to_string(index=False)); print("total",total); print(d2.to_string(index=False))'
